text:
mia: Hey @runtime-team @platform-team @infra-team @security — PR 3287 is ready. It's a small routing toggle + a default batch-size tweak that helps cost on tail workloads. Need approvals and a merge slot today if possible.

sam: pinged. can you paste the exact config diff so I can eyeball risks?

mia: sure — snippet below. no schema changes, just a rollout flag and batch hint.

mia: ```yaml
routing:
  prefer_low_cost_variant: true
  low_capacity_threshold: 0.2  # percent of pool free
serving:
  default_batch_size_hint: 8
```

jordan: runtime note: LGTM on the routing logic, but FYI this bumps the KV cache hit slightly in my local sim. can we stay conservative on the canary? recommend 5–10% traffic for first 30m.

lisa: infra: network/noise looks fine. we'll want a brief canary slot and a rollback playbook in case autoscaler reacts weirdly. i can own rollback steps.

anika: security: no new secrets introduced, but please link the threat model / dataflow proof. also confirm no new external endpoints.

mia: confirming: no keys, no external endpoints. linking the short note: https://internal.redwood/papers/pr-3287-dataflow (internal).

sam: i'll review code + tests in the next hour. if runtime + infra + sec approve, i can merge into staging and schedule canary.

deploy-bot: Canary window availability: 18:30–19:30 PT today is free.

ryan: i'm oncall and can monitor logs/alerts for the 18:30 slot. pls @me right before merge.

mia: thanks — added reviewers: @jordan, @lisa, @anika, @ryan. tagging for final thumbs. plan: merge to staging after approvals, run 10% canary 18:30 PT, promote to prod if no regressions by 19:00. :thumbsup:

jordan: approved from runtime side, will watch perf. :white_check_mark:

lisa: infra approved, rollback doc is in the PR description. :ok_hand:

anika: security approved — no outstanding issues. :lock:

sam: code review done, minor nits addressed, i'm happy for you to merge when ready.

mia: merging to staging in ~10m. will ping here before canary. thanks all! :rocket:
